name: leg-a-read-from-the-archived-logs
why: THE FALLBACK PATH, which the live dry epoch needs. Every run here omits `finalBuild` and `heldoutFinal` from result.json — the shape of a run collected before those fields existed — leaving only the archived `.ho_final.txt` and `.src_final.txt` that `run-pair.sh` has always written. The analyzer must recover both facts from those logs and adjudicate identically to the `hit` case, because this is an analysis-layer fix and no data is lost. If it instead fell back to `escapedBugs`, or failed closed on an epoch that HAS the evidence, the whole dry run would be unreadable.
